name: handoff-watch
description: Watches context fill against the auto-compact point and nudges for a session handoff doc at a quiet moment, before auto-compact

showAt.title: Show status from
showAt.description: Context fill (0-1, fraction of the auto-compact point) below which the status line stays empty.

warnAt.title: Nudge from
warnAt.description: Context fill (0-1) from which a handoff nudge becomes due.

urgentAt.title: Urgent at
urgentAt.description: Context fill (0-1) at which the nudge fires at the next turn end, without waiting for a quiet turn or a commit.

remindEvery.title: Remind every
remindEvery.description: Extra fill (0-1) after a handoff or a nudge before the next nudge.

maxWaitTurns.title: Max turns to wait for a checkpoint
maxWaitTurns.description: Busy turns to wait for a quiet turn or a git commit before nudging anyway. 0 nudges at the first turn end.

handoffDir.title: Handoff folder
handoffDir.description: Where handoff docs go, relative to the project root. Empty = the project root.

compactInstructions.title: Steer compaction summaries
compactInstructions.description: Before a compaction of the main conversation, ask the summarizer to keep the goal, files, verified vs assumed facts, open questions, next steps and the last handoff path.

autoClear.title: Clear after a handoff
autoClear.description: When a handoff doc is written during a turn, run /clear once that turn's answer is out.

autoResume.title: Resume after /clear
autoResume.description: After a /clear that follows a handoff doc (automatic or typed), submit a prompt into the fresh conversation that reads the doc and continues its next steps.
